matches.title: Gillingham vs Luton
matches.description: Watch Gillingham vs Luton highlights and goals from Carabao on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 8, 2026. The Carabao Cup took center stage on August 8, 2026, as Gillingham welcomed Luton Town for a knockout encounter under the lights. Fans at the stadium were treated to a tactical battle as both sides vied for a spot in the next round of the competition. Luton Take Control Early From the opening whistle, Luton Town displayed their intent to dictate play. As early as the 2nd minute, Jake Richards forced a sharp save from Owen Mason , setting the tone for a busy evening for the Gillingham goalkeeper. The pressure continued to mount as Jordan Clark saw multiple efforts saved in the 13th minute, with the visitors consistently finding gaps in the home side's defensive lines. The deadlock was finally broken in the 43rd minute. A perfectly weighted through ball from Jayden Luker found Nahki Wells in the center of the box. The striker made no mistake, sliding a right-footed shot into the bottom right corner to give the visitors a deserved lead just before the break. Gillingham had struggled to create clear-cut chances, with a James Brophy header earlier in the half being their most notable effort. Clinical Finishing Doubles the Advantage The second half began with an early setback for Luton Town as Jayden Luker was forced off due to injury, replaced by Kasey Palmer . However, the momentum remained firmly with the visitors. In the 59th minute, Benedict Benagr found himself in the right place at the right time, converting from close range to double the lead. The goal followed a period of sustained pressure and a fast break that left the Gillingham defense scrambling. In an attempt to change the course of the match, Gillingham introduced five substitutes simultaneously in the 67th minute, including Will Goodwin and Sullivan Booth . While Goodwin did manage to test Josh Keeley with a low shot in the 85th minute, the home side found it difficult to consistently break through a disciplined Luton midfield. Sealing the Victory Any hopes of a late comeback were extinguished in the 78th minute. Following a corner, substitute Gideon Kodua rose highest to power a header into the center of the goal from very close range. The 3-0 scoreline reflected Luton's dominance throughout the encounter. As the match entered eight minutes of stoppage time, Kodua nearly added a fourth but saw his effort strike the left post. Despite a late flurry of attempts from Sullivan Booth and Harry Waldock for the hosts, the Luton Town defense held firm. The final whistle confirmed a comprehensive victory for the visitors, sending them through to the next stage of the Carabao Cup .
